sections.title: Introduction
paragraphs: I am a full-stack software engineer focused on building cloud-oriented, production-ready applications and maintainable software systems.

sections.title: What I Do
paragraphs: I work across the application lifecycle, connecting product-facing interfaces with backend services, data storage, deployment, and ongoing system operation.

sections.title: Current Role
paragraphs: I currently work as a Software Development Engineer (RDSS) at eZoom Information, Inc., contributing to government-related information systems.
My responsibilities span full-stack system development and production maintenance.

sections.title: Engineering Approach
paragraphs: I approach software development by establishing clear architecture and data boundaries, then improving systems incrementally without compromising reliability.

sections.title: Technical Background
paragraphs: My technical background covers frontend, backend, relational databases, containerized deployment, and delivery automation.

sections.title: Current Focus
paragraphs: I am continuing to develop my engineering practice through architecture work, automation, cloud-native delivery, and the ongoing improvement of this portfolio.
